title: Horus UI theme description
description: JSON format consumed by hui::loadThemeFromJson(). A theme describes fonts, user settings and per-state visual data (9-slice PNG images, tints, borders, text colors and shadow) for every widget element of the UI.

fonts.description: Named fonts. Each entry maps a name that state definitions can reference via the 'font' field. File paths without a ':' are resolved relative to the theme JSON file directory.

settings.description: Arbitrary string key/value store read at runtime with themeGetUserSetting(). Only string values are stored, non-string values are ignored.

widgets.description: Required. Maps a widget name to its style definitions. Names recognized by the loader (button, slider, table, ...) describe built-in widgets; any other name is treated as a user (custom) widget whose elements are addressed by name in code.

font.description: A font reference: a TTF/OTF file and a face size in pixels.

file.description: Path to the TTF/OTF file. A path without ':' is resolved relative to the theme JSON file; a path containing ':' (e.g. a drive letter or URL scheme) is used as-is.

widget.description: A widget either declares an explicit 'styles' object, or, when no 'styles' key is present, the widget object itself is the description of the 'default' style.

styles.description: One named style per key (the conventional default is 'default'). The active style is chosen at runtime with widgetSetStyle().

widgetImplicitStyle.description: A widget written without the 'styles' key: the object members are elements and form the widget's 'default' style.

style.description: A named style: maps an element name to its element description. Element names recognized by the loader address built-in elements (see getWidgetElementFromName()); any other name is stored as a user element.

element.description: An element description: default dimensions plus per-state visuals and style parameters. States are keyed normal, focused, pressed, hovered, disabled; any other key is treated as a style parameter (string values are stored, numeric values are ignored, 'width'/'height' are element dimensions).

width.description: Default element width in pixels. Used for every state that does not override it.

height.description: Default element height in pixels. Used for every state that does not override it.

elementMember.description: Any non width/height member of an element: either a widget state (an object) or a style parameter (a string). Numeric values are allowed in the shipped themes but are ignored by the loader.

oneOf.description: Style parameter value, converted to a number or color by the widget code (themeGetWidgetElementParameterFloat/Color).
Accepted for compatibility with the shipped themes but ignored by the loader.

state.description: Visual description of an element in one widget state. A state member like 'normal' overrides the previous state for the members it sets; unset members inherit from 'normal' (or from the loader defaults when no 'normal' is present).

image.description: PNG image base name without extension, resolved relative to the theme JSON directory: 'default/button_normal' loads '<themeDir>/default/button_normal.png'. An empty string leaves the element with the fallback white image tinted by 'color'.

border.description: 9-slice border thickness in pixels. The border defines the unscaled corners of the image.

color.description: Tint/multiply color applied to the element image. With the fallback white image this becomes the flat fill color.

textColor.description: Color of the text rendered over the element.

font.description: Name of a font declared in the 'fonts' section.

width.description: Element width in pixels for this state.

height.description: Element height in pixels for this state.

textShadow.description: When present, enables a text shadow drawn behind the element text.

color.description: A named color (white, black, red, darkRed, veryDarkRed, green, darkGreen, veryDarkGreen, blue, darkBlue, veryDarkBlue, yellow, darkYellow, veryDarkYellow, magenta, cyan, darkCyan, veryDarkCyan, orange, darkOrange, lightGray, gray, darkGray, sky, transparent) or a 'R G B A' string of four integers in the 0..255 range, e.g. '155 200 200 255'.
